messages:
Mona: Quick sync — we need to shift priorities for the Optimize toolkit pilot after the ACME pilot asks landed. Short version: eval-triggered alerts become P0 for pilot, caching recommendations P1, batching experiments P2. Need estimates + launch/gating criteria by EOD.

Ryan: Ack. When you say eval-triggered alerts, do you mean perf regressions only or also semantic/quality drift?

Mona: Both. Perf + quality drift. Example trigger: eval set `acme_core` rolling 1k requests, fluency score drops > 3 pts OR rerank score delta > 0.08 => raise alert. Must include FP suppression.

Alex: Noted. Batching note: dynamic batch sizing (autoscale batch by queue depth) is non-trivial. Prototype + runtime safety nets ~2 sprints. If alerts are P0 and require quick rollout, we should keep batching P2 unless customer insists.

Tess: For caching recs we should provide ready-to-apply knobs. Initial draft: 
```
cache.prefix_enabled=true
route_ttl_secs=300
stale_if_error_secs=60
cache.per_customer=false
```
Also include recommended metrics to surface (cache hit ratio, stale-served count). I can draft today.

Sam: From SRE: alerting must not page on noise. Suggested flow: alert -> #optimize-alerts (passive) with summary + suggested actions -> if unchanged for 30min escalate to oncall. Add rate-limit on alert firing (eg 1/min per route).

Priya: Customer acceptance criteria (ACME ask): 1) Alert arrives with failing eval snapshot + top-3 diffs, 2) Suggested rollback model variant OR recommended config change, 3) Runbook link + one-click opt-out per project. We should prototype UI text too.

deploy-bot: CI: optimize/pilot/alerts v0.2 deployed to canary. Tests: 112 passed, 3 flaky. Canary window open 30m.

Mona: Great. Action items (quick): Ryan & Alex: concrete estimates for batching (prototype + safety) — deliver by EOD. Tess: caching config + docs draft — 1d. Sam: alert policy + runbook draft — 3d. Priya: customer AC + opt-out UX copy — 2d. I’ll own acceptance gating and final sign-off. Reconvene tomorrow 10:00am. @here react with :thumbsup: if this plan looks ok.

Ryan: :thumbsup:

Alex: 👍 adding to sprint board and flagging infra dependency.

Tess: 👍 will post doc link when draft is ready.

Sam: Noted, I’ll include pageless escalation + sample alert payload.

Priya: Will draft customer-facing AC and share example alert text.

Mona: Thanks everyone — if anyone thinks batching must be earlier, speak now; otherwise we'll proceed with this reorder and update the pilot spec.

Alex: One quick ask — can we include a simple opt-in toggle for dynamic batching by customer? If we keep batching P2 at least the toggle lets power users try it.

Mona: Good idea. Add toggle to Tess's doc as a rollout option.

deploy-bot: Reminder: canary ends in 22m.

Mona: Ok closing thread for now, will post the updated pilot spec link here after the 10am sync.
